note: Trial plan for John 6: the top two ideas for each picture are made as candidates and the better is chosen by eye (steps in TV_PICTURES.md).

sections.meaning: A great crowd follows him because of the healings, and when they must be fed, all the disciples can find is one boy's small lunch: what is that for so many?
ideas: A long stream of ordinary people, some on crutches or in wheelchairs or on a son's arm, walking up a wide grassy hillside above a lake, seen from behind
A vast crowd covering a grassy hillside above a lake, seen from far above
A small boy's hands held out offering five little barley rolls and two small fish wrapped in a cloth, a huge crowd blurred behind him
Five small rolls and two small fish on a cloth on a rock, a hillside packed with thousands below
A man looks into his wallet holding a few coins while a long queue of hungry people stretches away
A single lunchbox on a long empty banquet table set for thousands
A volunteer at a soup kitchen looks at one small pot while the queue goes round the block
A child's paper lunch bag held up against a stadium-sized crowd
Two hands cupping a tiny handful of grain over a vast empty field
A father adds up a long grocery bill and frowns at his empty wallet

sections.meaning: Given thanks for and shared out, the little feeds everyone as much as they want, and the leftovers are gathered so that nothing is lost.
ideas: A green hillside covered with people sitting in groups on thick grass, eating bread and fish, contented, baskets passing among them
Many hands passing a basket of bread rolls along a row of people sitting on grass, the basket still full
Twelve woven baskets full to the brim with broken bread standing in a row on the grass after the crowd has gone
Hands carefully picking up broken pieces of bread from the grass and putting them into a full basket
A child with cheeks full and a piece of bread in each hand, laughing, a crowd eating behind
A table after a family feast with every plate clean and the bread basket still overflowing
A pitcher that keeps pouring into a long row of cups
An old woman gathering crumbs from a tablecloth into her palm
Volunteers stacking full crates of leftover bread at the end of a fair
A sunset picnic where people lie back on the grass, satisfied

sections.meaning: They want to seize him and make him king because of the bread, and he withdraws again onto the mountain, alone.
ideas: A quiet mountain summit at dusk with a single narrow path climbing into it, the lights of a crowd far below in the valley
A golden crown lying unclaimed on a rock beside a mountain path that climbs on alone into the evening clouds
A crowd's raised hands reaching toward an empty hilltop
An empty throne-like chair left in a field as the evening falls
A lone path through pines winding up into mist
A crown left on a wooden table by an open door that leads outside to hills
A cheering stadium with an empty stage
A mountain cabin with one lit window high above a crowded town
A narrow ridge trail in blue evening light with no one on it
A banner-lined street left empty after a parade

sections.meaning: In the dark on a rough sea, without him, they are afraid; he comes to them saying 'It is I; do not fear', and at once they are at the shore.
ideas: At night on a wind-whipped lake, a small wooden rowing boat with a few people in rain jackets pulling hard at the oars, spray breaking over the bow
A small boat with one lamp far out alone on a dark, stormy lake under black clouds
The same small rowing boat resting with its bow on a calm sandy shore at first light, oars laid down, the water still
Rowers in rain jackets stepping out onto a calm beach at dawn, relieved, the sea now still behind them
A frightened face lit by lightning in a boat
A lighthouse beam crossing a storm
A child afraid of thunder comforted by a parent's hand on his shoulder
Wet oars resting crossed in a boat on glass-calm water
A harbor wall with a small boat sliding safely in out of the waves
A dark sea under a breaking dawn

sections.meaning: The crowd chases him because the bread filled them; he tells them to work not for food that perishes but for the food that lasts into eternal life, and the work God asks is to believe.
ideas: Morning on a big lake, many small boats packed with people heading across toward a town on the far shore
People hurrying along a lakeside jetty climbing eagerly into small boats
A loaf of bread left on a table gone dry, cracked and mouldy
Three loaves on a board: one fresh, one dry and cracked, one covered in mould
A tired man in work clothes eating a sandwich alone in a parked truck at night
A crowd pushing toward a food truck
A fridge full of food gone bad
A shiny new car rusting in a field
A hungry crowd at a bakery window at dawn
Fruit rotting on a market stall at the end of the day

sections.meaning: The true bread from heaven is not the manna the fathers ate long ago but what the Father gives now, and it gives life to the world.
ideas: Dawn in a rocky desert, the ground everywhere covered with small white flakes like frost, glistening
A desert at dawn with a thin white layer on the ground and a woven basket half full beside it
A father's hands, seen over his shoulder, handing a warm round loaf down into a small child's reaching hands
A father seen from behind setting a fresh loaf on the table before his hungry children, their faces lit with joy
Sunlight falling through a gap in clouds onto a waking town
Rain falling on a dry field turning it green
Children holding out empty bowls toward a kitchen window
A loaf of bread on a windowsill in morning light
An old photo of a grandfather's bakery beside a fresh loaf
Hands lifting a loaf from an oven

sections.meaning: He is the bread of life: whoever comes to him is never turned away or hungry again, and none of those given to him will be lost but raised up on the last day.
ideas: A warm open doorway at night, a table with bread inside, a weary traveller with a backpack welcomed in by an arm reaching out from inside
A round loaf broken open on a plain table, steam rising, a place set for a guest
Fresh green shoots rising out of dark earth in a field at sunrise
A father lifting his small child up high from the ground into his arms, seen from behind
A shepherd counting sheep through a gate, every one there
A lost child found and lifted up in a crowd
A beggar welcomed at a family's table
A string of pearls gathered back up with none missing
A hand pulling someone up from a hole
A sunrise over a sleeping town

sections.meaning: They grumble because they know his family, but no one can come to him unless the Father draws him and teaches him.
ideas: Small-town neighbours standing in a street with arms crossed, muttering to each other with sideways, sceptical looks
Older people on a porch whispering behind their hands and shaking their heads
A father kneeling on a lawn with open arms, seen from behind, a toddler taking wobbly steps toward him
A father's hand gently leading a small child's hand along a garden path toward home
A fisherman drawing in a net
A kite pulled up by its string
A father teaching his child to read at the kitchen table
A magnet drawing iron filings
A mother calling her child home at dusk from the porch
Townsfolk looking at an old family photo with doubt

sections.meaning: Those who ate the manna died; the living bread he gives is himself, given so that the world may live forever.
ideas: Two hands breaking a large round loaf in half, many hands of people of every age and colour reaching in to receive pieces
A long outdoor table stretching to the horizon with people of every nation sharing one broken loaf
Bread handed out at a city street corner to a long line of all kinds of people
An old desert path with weathered stones, the past gone
A loaf on a table in the middle of a globe-like round of faces
A mother giving her own portion to her children
A seed breaking open in the soil
Hands offering bread across a border fence
A grandfather sharing his bread with grandchildren
A candle giving its light to many

sections.meaning: As food and drink are taken in and become life, whoever feeds on him remains in him and he in them, and lives because of him as he lives because of the Father.
ideas: A tired, gaunt hiker on a rock eating bread with both hands, eyes closed in relief, strength returning
Men around a table arguing hotly, hands raised
A tree with deep roots beside a stream in dry country, green while the land around is brown
A baby asleep on his father's chest, the father's arms around him, father's face not shown
A child eating breakfast at a kitchen table, morning light
A plant drinking water through its roots in a glass jar
A runner after a race eating and recovering
A newborn's hand gripping a father's finger
A family meal where everyone eats from the same loaf
A tree whose sap rises into its branches in spring

sections.meaning: His words are hard, and many of his disciples turn back and no longer walk with him.
ideas: An open-air gathering on a hillside where most of the folding chairs are now empty and people walk away down the slope, backs turned, only a few still sitting
A crowd on a country road turning around and walking back the way they came, the road ahead empty
A listener frowning with folded arms
People getting up and leaving a hall mid-talk
Many footprints on a path turning around
A man covering his ears
A crowd dispersing in the rain
An empty chair with a jacket left on it
A trail where most hikers turn back at a hard climb
A train platform emptying

sections.meaning: Asked if they will go too, the twelve answer: to whom would we go? He alone has words of eternal life, yet even among them is one who will hand him over.
ideas: A handful of friends sitting close together on the grass of the emptied field, earnest faces turned toward someone off frame, empty chairs behind them
A small group of friends standing together on an empty road, not following the crowd walking away in the distance
A man at a fork in a road choosing to stay on the hard path
A circle of friends arm in arm seen from behind, one slipping away into the shadow
A dog that stays at the gate when others leave
A few lights left on in a dark street
A man holding on to a rope in a current
Friends at a table with one chair pushed back and empty
A small boat that stays in harbor while others sail
A sunrise shared by a few people on a hill

candidates.shows: A long stream of people, some of them sick or lame, walking up a grassy hillside above a lake.
candidates.prompt: Seen from behind and a little above, a long stream of ordinary people of every age walks up a wide green grassy hillside above a large lake: a man on crutches, an old woman leaning on her grown son's arm, a girl in a wheelchair being pushed, families carrying small children, all heading the same way up the slope toward the top of the hill. Bright clear midday light, blue lake and far hills behind.

candidates.shows: A vast crowd covering a grassy hillside above a lake.
candidates.prompt: A vast crowd of thousands of ordinary people sitting and standing all over a wide grassy hillside above a large blue lake, seen from far away and above so the people are small, the hill green and the lake shining. Clear late-morning light with white clouds.

candidates.shows: A small boy's hands offering five small rolls and two small fish, with a huge crowd behind.
candidates.prompt: Close view of a small boy of about seven, seen from the chest down, holding out in both hands a small cloth bundle opened to show five little round barley bread rolls and two small dried fish. Behind him, out of focus, a huge crowd of people fills a grassy hillside all the way to the top of the frame. Soft overcast daylight.

candidates.shows: Five small rolls and two small fish on a cloth on a rock, with a hillside packed with thousands below.
candidates.prompt: On a flat rock in the foreground at the upper middle of the frame sits a small checked cloth with five little round barley bread rolls and two small dried fish on it. Beyond and below the rock, a vast crowd of thousands of people covers a grassy hillside down to a lake. Clear bright afternoon light.

candidates.shows: A hillside full of people sitting in groups on the grass, all eating bread and fish, contented.
candidates.prompt: A wide green hillside covered with people sitting in groups on thick grass, families and friends, every one of them eating bread and fish and smiling, baskets of bread being passed from group to group. Soft golden afternoon light, a lake glimpsed beyond. A sense of plenty and contentment.

candidates.shows: Many hands passing a basket of bread along a row of people on the grass, the basket still full.
candidates.prompt: A woven basket heaped with bread rolls is being passed from hand to hand along a long row of people sitting on thick green grass; each person takes a roll and the basket is still overflowing. Many hands and smiling faces, a crowd sitting and eating behind. Bright midday light.

candidates.shows: Twelve baskets full to the brim with broken bread standing in a row on the grass.
candidates.prompt: Twelve woven baskets, each full to the brim with broken pieces of bread, stand in a neat row across a grassy hillside after a meal, the grass pressed flat where a crowd has sat. Calm late-afternoon light with long soft shadows, a lake beyond.

candidates.shows: Hands picking up the leftover pieces of bread from the grass into a full basket.
candidates.prompt: Close view of a pair of hands carefully picking up broken pieces of bread from thick green grass and putting them into a woven basket that is already full to the brim, more full baskets beside it. Warm soft daylight.

candidates.shows: A lone path climbing into a quiet mountain at dusk, the lights of a crowd far below.
candidates.prompt: A narrow dirt path climbs alone up a steep quiet mountainside into the high rocks and the evening sky. Far below in the valley at the bottom edge of the hills, the many small campfires and lanterns of a great crowd glow. Deep blue dusk light, the first stars.

candidates.shows: A crown lying unclaimed on a rock beside a mountain path that climbs on alone.
candidates.prompt: A simple gold crown lies unclaimed on a flat rock beside a narrow mountain path; the path climbs on past it, empty, up into high cool evening clouds. Quiet blue evening light.

candidates.shows: At night on a rough lake, a small rowing boat with people pulling hard at the oars, afraid.
candidates.prompt: At night on a wind-whipped lake, a small wooden rowing boat with five people in rain jackets pulling hard at the oars, spray breaking over the bow, their faces strained and afraid, lit by a single lantern in the boat. Dark clouds and high waves all round. The only people are the ones in the boat.

candidates.shows: A small boat with one lamp far out alone on a dark stormy lake.
candidates.prompt: A small rowing boat with one lantern glowing is alone far out on a dark, stormy lake at night, high waves and black clouds all around, the wind tearing spray off the waves. The boat is small in the upper middle of the frame.

candidates.shows: The same small rowing boat resting with its bow on a calm shore at first light, the water still.
candidates.prompt: A small wooden rowing boat rests with its bow drawn up on a calm sandy shore at first light, its oars laid down inside, the lake behind it smooth as glass, a clear pale sky. Peaceful, still and safe.

candidates.shows: Rowers stepping out onto a calm beach at dawn, relieved, the water now still.
candidates.prompt: Five people in wet rain jackets step out of a small wooden rowing boat onto a calm sandy beach at dawn, their faces relieved and at peace, the lake behind them now smooth and still under a clearing sky.

candidates.shows: Many small boats packed with people heading across a lake toward a town on the far shore.
candidates.prompt: Morning on a big calm lake: many small boats packed with ordinary people are all heading across the water in the same direction toward a small town on the far shore, people leaning forward and looking ahead eagerly. Clear morning light, soft haze on the water.

candidates.shows: People hurrying along a lakeside jetty to climb into small boats, looking out across the water.
candidates.prompt: On a wooden lakeside jetty a crowd of ordinary people hurries to climb into small boats, some already pushing off, others pointing across the water to the far shore. Bright morning light, blue water.

candidates.shows: A loaf of bread left on a table, gone dry, cracked and mouldy.
candidates.prompt: A once-fine loaf of bread sits alone on a plain wooden kitchen table, dried out, cracked and spotted with grey-green mould, a few stale crumbs around it. Cool plain daylight from a window.

candidates.shows: Three loaves on a board: one fresh, one dry and cracked, one covered in mould.
candidates.prompt: On a long wooden board, three loaves of bread in a row: the first fresh and golden, the second dry and cracked, the third covered in grey-green mould. Plain daylight from a window on a kitchen table.

candidates.shows: Dawn in a desert, the ground everywhere covered with small white flakes like frost.
candidates.prompt: Dawn in a wide rocky desert, the ground everywhere covered with small round white flakes like frost or coriander seed, glistening in the cool first light, the dew lifting off it in thin mist.

candidates.shows: A desert at dawn with a thin white layer on the ground and a woven basket half full beside it.
candidates.prompt: A woven basket half full of small white flakes sits on desert ground that is covered with a thin layer of the same white flakes, like frost, in pale dawn light, the desert stretching away to distant hills.

candidates.shows: A father's hands handing a warm loaf of bread down into a small child's reaching hands.
candidates.prompt: Seen over a father's shoulder, his strong hands hand a warm round loaf of bread down into a small child's eagerly reaching hands at a kitchen table; the child's face is lit with joy. The father's face is not shown. Bright morning light from a window.

candidates.shows: A father seen from behind setting a fresh loaf on the table before his hungry children.
candidates.prompt: A father, seen from behind, sets a fresh, warm loaf of bread on the table in front of his three hungry young children, whose faces light up with joy. Plain home kitchen, morning light.

candidates.shows: A warm open doorway at night, bread on the table inside, a weary traveller welcomed in.
candidates.prompt: At night, a front door stands wide open and warm light pours out; inside, a table is laid with bread. A weary traveller with a backpack, seen from behind, stands on the step as an arm reaches out from inside the door to welcome him in. Cool blue night outside, golden light within.

candidates.shows: A round loaf broken open on a plain table, steam rising, a place set for a guest.
candidates.prompt: A round loaf of bread broken open on a plain wooden table, steam rising from its soft inside, an empty plate and chair set ready for a guest. Soft morning light.

candidates.shows: Fresh green shoots rising out of dark earth in a field at sunrise.
candidates.prompt: Close to the ground, countless fresh green shoots rise up out of dark, moist earth, fresh and strong, a field stretching behind them. Early morning light.

candidates.shows: A father lifting his small child up high from the ground into his arms, seen from behind.
candidates.prompt: A father, seen from behind, lifts his small child up high from the grass into the air with both arms, the child laughing with arms spread wide. Bright morning light in an open park.

candidates.shows: Small-town neighbours standing in a street with arms crossed, muttering with sideways, sceptical looks.
candidates.prompt: In a small-town street, a group of neighbours stand together with arms crossed, muttering to each other with sideways, sceptical looks and frowns, one of them shaking his head. Plain overcast daylight.

candidates.shows: Older people on a porch whispering behind their hands and shaking their heads.
candidates.prompt: Older men and women sitting on a wooden front porch whisper to each other behind their hands and shake their heads, looking sceptically at something out of the frame. Plain afternoon light.

candidates.shows: A father kneeling with open arms, seen from behind, a toddler taking wobbly steps toward him.
candidates.prompt: A father, seen from behind, kneels on a green lawn with his arms open wide, and a toddler takes wobbly first steps toward him, smiling, arms reaching. Bright soft morning light.

candidates.shows: A father's hand gently leading a small child's hand along a garden path toward home.
candidates.prompt: Close view of a father's large hand gently holding a small child's hand and leading the child along a garden path toward a house with a lit window. Only hands and arms of the father. Soft evening light.

candidates.shows: Two hands breaking a large round loaf, many hands of every age and colour reaching in to receive pieces.
candidates.prompt: Two hands break a large round loaf of bread in half in the upper middle of the frame, and all around it many hands of people of every age and skin colour reach in to receive pieces. Warm soft daylight.

candidates.shows: Bread handed out at a city street corner to a long line of all kinds of people.
candidates.prompt: At a city street corner, hands give out pieces of bread from one large broken loaf to a long line of all kinds of people, old and young, rich and poor, of every background. Clear morning light.

candidates.shows: A tired, gaunt hiker eating bread with both hands, eyes closed in relief, strength returning.
candidates.prompt: A tired, gaunt hiker sits on a rock on a mountain trail eating a piece of bread with both hands, eyes closed in relief, colour returning to his face. Clear midday light.

candidates.shows: Men around a table arguing hotly, hands raised.
candidates.prompt: Men around a wooden table arguing hotly with one another, hands raised and faces frowning. Plain daylight from a window, no violence.

candidates.shows: A tree with deep roots beside a stream in dry country, green while the land around is brown.
candidates.prompt: A broad tree with deep roots reaching into a small clear stream stands green and full of leaves in a dry, brown country. Bright clear midday light.

candidates.shows: A baby asleep on his father's chest, the father's arms around him.
candidates.prompt: A baby sleeps peacefully on his father's chest, wrapped in a soft blanket, the father's arms holding him close. The father's face is not shown, only his chest, shoulders and arms in a plain shirt. Soft morning light.

candidates.shows: An open-air gathering where most of the chairs are now empty and people walk away down the slope.
candidates.prompt: An open-air gathering on a grassy hillside: most of the many rows of folding chairs are now empty, and people walk away down the slope in twos and threes with their backs turned, only a few still sitting. Overcast grey afternoon light.

candidates.shows: A crowd on a country road turning around and walking back the way they came.
candidates.prompt: On a long country road, a crowd of people has turned around and is walking back the way they came, their backs to the camera; the road ahead is empty. Overcast grey afternoon light.

candidates.shows: A handful of friends sitting close together in the emptied field, earnest faces turned toward someone off frame.
candidates.prompt: A handful of friends sit close together on the grass in an emptied field, their earnest faces turned toward someone just out of the frame, empty folding chairs behind them. Soft evening light.

candidates.shows: A small group of friends standing together on an empty road, not following the crowd walking away in the distance.
candidates.prompt: A small group of friends stands together on an empty road, not following the crowd walking away in the distance. Soft evening light.
